statement: Widened enumeration scans factor count 0..6, ranks 1..6, and U(1)-role count 0..3, with 3699 total candidates including known alternatives.
Known chiral alternatives SU(5), SO(10), and SU(6)_chiral_example are admitted with computed non-minimal reasons.
Under total-rank-first minimality, r1|2_u1 with dimensions 2|3 remains the primary winner.
Criteria variation is stable in 8/9 settings but factor-count-first flips the winner to SU(5), so uniqueness is criteria-dependent.
Negative controls fail by computed verdict and all six gates pass.
Finite stress test only; not physical E019 closure and no frame-transfer status upgrade.
